articles.title_en: Contracting and search with heterogeneous principals and agents
articles.title_cn: 异质委托人与代理人的契约与搜寻
articles.abstract_en: This paper incorporates a risk-neutral principal-agent problem into a random search model to study contracting and search in general equilibrium. I introduce heterogeneity in principals' and agents' production technologies in terms of the distribution of output across states of nature. Under optimal contracting, this heterogeneity can give rise to complementarity in contracting between specific principal and agent types. In contrast to complementarity in production, complementarity in contracting affects only the division of the surplus but not its size and can induce principals to engage in overly intense search before forming a match. I show that a reduction in search frictions and contractual innovations can induce principals to engage in overly intense search.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文将风险中性的委托-代理问题纳入随机搜寻模型，以研究一般均衡中的契约与搜寻。我引入了委托人和代理人在生产技术上的异质性，这种异质性体现在产出在不同自然状态下的分布上。在最优契约下，这种异质性可能导致特定委托人与代理人类型之间的契约互补性。与生产中的互补性不同，契约中的互补性仅影响剩余的分割而不影响其大小，并可能诱使委托人在形成匹配之前进行过度激烈的搜寻。我表明，搜寻摩擦的减少和契约创新可以诱使委托人进行过度激烈的搜寻。

articles.abstract_en: A principal delegates a problem to an agent. The agent solves the problem by conducting independent trials. Each trial is privately costly and produces the solution with some probability. The principal relies on the agent to report the solution before realizing its benefits. The ability to conceal the solution enables the agent to extract rents from the principal. The optimal contract with commitment balances the agent's rents against the timeliness of the solution, and typically induces the agent to inefficiently idle. The optimal renegotiation-proof contract eliminates idleness, maximizes total surplus, yet cedes significant further rents to the agent. A principal that lacks commitment might optimally slow down problem solving by increasing the time taken to perform trials.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人将一个问题委托给代理人。代理人通过进行独立试验来解决问题。每次试验私下产生成本，并以一定概率得出解决方案。委托人在实现收益之前依赖代理人报告解决方案。隐瞒解决方案的能力使代理人能够从委托人那里获取租金。具有承诺的最优契约在代理人租金与解决方案的及时性之间进行权衡，并且通常会导致代理人低效地闲置。最优的防再谈判契约消除了闲置，最大化总剩余，但将更多显著租金让渡给代理人。缺乏承诺的委托人可能通过增加试验所需时间来最优地减缓问题解决速度。

articles.title_cn: 肾脏交换中的目标冲突
articles.abstract_en: There is no conflict between maximizing the number of transplants and giving priority to, e.g., highly HLA-sensitized recipients in kidney exchange programs that only permit pairwise exchanges. In some programs that feature cyclic exchanges or chains, however, giving priority to some recipients may reduce the number of transplants that can be carried out. This paper identifies the conditions under which there is a trade-off between prioritization and transplant maximization objectives. The results show that kidney exchange programs can permit some cyclic exchanges and chains without introducing such trade-offs. Whether or not a kidney exchange program has conflicting objectives and regardless of how recipients are prioritized, it can ensure a Pareto efficient outcome by selecting from a new class of matchings. These generalize several classes of matchings used in practice and studied in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 在仅允许配对交换的肾脏交换项目中，最大化移植数量与优先考虑例如高度HLA致敏受者之间并不存在冲突。然而，在涉及循环交换或链式交换的某些项目中，优先考虑某些受者可能会减少可进行的移植数量。本文识别了优先化与移植最大化目标之间存在权衡的条件。结果表明，肾脏交换项目可以允许某些循环交换和链式交换而不引入此类权衡。无论肾脏交换项目是否存在目标冲突，也不论受者如何被优先排序，通过从一类新的匹配中选择，都可以确保帕累托有效的结果。这些匹配推广了实践中使用并在文献中研究的几类匹配。

articles.title_en: Money under the mattress: Inflation and lending of last resort
articles.title_cn: 床垫下的货币：通货膨胀与最后贷款人
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether the two key functions of central banks—ensuring price stability and lending during crises—necessarily conflict. We develop a nominal model of bank runs à la Diamond and Dybvig (1983) in which individuals can store the money they withdraw “under the mattress.” In this setting, lending of last resort need not be inflationary. Whether it is depends on the interest rates the central bank charges on its loans. Our results suggest that the central bank must not charge a rate that is too low if it wants to ensure price stability, and must charge a high rate if it wants to robustly attain the ex-ante efficient outcome. These rationales for charging high interest rates on loans during a crisis are distinct from the arguments Bagehot originally relied on to advocate for a similar rule.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了中央银行的两项关键职能——确保价格稳定和危机期间贷款——是否必然冲突。我们构建了一个Diamond和Dybvig（1983）式的银行挤兑名义模型，在该模型中，个人可以将提取的货币“藏在床垫下”。在这种设定下，最后贷款人贷款不必然具有通货膨胀性。是否具有通货膨胀性取决于中央银行对其贷款收取的利率。我们的结果表明，如果中央银行想要确保价格稳定，就不能收取过低的利率；而如果它想要稳健地实现事前有效结果，则必须收取高利率。这些在危机期间对贷款收取高利率的理由，与Bagehot最初主张类似规则时所依赖的论据是不同的。

articles.title_en: Haves and have-nots: A theory of economic sufficientarianism
articles.title_cn: 有与无：经济充分主义理论
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we introduce a generalization of the concept of sufficientarianism, extending it to assess allocations across multiple consumption goods. For a fixed society of agents, sufficientarianism posits that allocations are compared according to the number of individuals whose consumption is considered to be sufficient. Central to our discussion is a newly introduced ethical principle of ‘sufficientrarian judgment.’ This principle asserts that if starting from an allocation in which all agents have identical consumption and a change in one agent's consumption hurts society, then there would be no change in the consumption of any other agent that could subsequently benefit society. Sufficientarianism is shown to be equivalent to sufficientarian judgment, symmetry, and separability. We investigate our axioms in both specific economic environments and abstract environments. Finally, we argue formally that sufficientarian judgment is closely related to the leximin principle.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们引入了充分主义概念的推广，将其扩展到评估多种消费商品下的配置。对于固定的社会主体集合，充分主义认为，配置的比较依据是消费被视为充分的个体数量。我们讨论的核心是一个新引入的伦理原则——“充分主义判断”。该原则断言，如果从一个所有主体消费相同的配置出发，某个主体消费的变化损害了社会，那么任何其他主体消费的变化都不可能随后使社会受益。充分主义被证明等价于充分主义判断、对称性和可分性。我们在特定经济环境和抽象环境中研究我们的公理。最后，我们正式论证充分主义判断与词典最小原则密切相关。

articles.abstract_en: We study the dynamics of fraud and trust in a continuous-time reputation game. The principal wishes to approve a real project and reject a fake. The agent is either an ethical type that produces a real project, or a strategic type that also can produce a fake. Producing a real project takes an uncertain amount of time, while a fake can be created instantaneously at some cost. The unique equilibrium features an initial phase of doubt, during which the strategic agent randomly fakes and the principal randomly approves. Only submissions that arrive after the phase of doubt are beneficial to the principal. We investigate three variants of the model that mitigate this problem. With full commitment, the principal incentivizes the strategic agent to fake at one specific time and commits to approve. Though the principal knows that earlier arrivals are real, she commits to reject them with positive probability. When she can delegate authority, the principal benefits by transferring it to a proxy who is more cautious than she is. When the principal can conduct a costly test prior to her approval decision, the principal also benefits. The equilibrium testing probability may be non-monotonic over time, first increasing, then decreasing.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究连续时间声誉博弈中欺诈与信任的动态。委托人希望批准真实项目并拒绝虚假项目。代理人要么是生产真实项目的道德类型，要么是也能生产虚假项目的战略类型。生产真实项目需要不确定的时间，而虚假项目可以立即以一定成本创建。唯一均衡具有初始怀疑阶段，在此期间战略代理人随机造假，委托人随机批准。只有在怀疑阶段之后到达的提交才有利于委托人。我们研究了该模型的三种变体以缓解此问题。在完全承诺下，委托人激励战略代理人在特定时间造假并承诺批准。尽管委托人知道较早到达的是真实的，但她承诺以正概率拒绝它们。当她可以委托权力时，委托人通过将其转移给比她更谨慎的代理人而受益。当委托人可以在批准决定之前进行昂贵的测试时，委托人也受益。均衡测试概率可能随时间非单调变化，先增加后减少。

articles.title_en: Fiscal stimulus with imperfect expectations: Spending vs. tax policy
articles.title_cn: 不完全预期下的财政刺激：支出政策与税收政策
articles.abstract_en: This paper addresses the question: how sensitive is the power of fiscal policy at the Zero Lower Bound (ZLB) to the assumption of rational expectations? We do so through the lens of a standard New Keynesian model in which people are dynamic level-k thinkers. Our analysis weakens the case for using government spending to stabilize the economy when the ZLB binds. The less sophisticated people are, the smaller the government-spending multiplier is. Our analysis strengthens the case for using tax policy to stabilize output when the ZLB is binding. The power of tax policy to stabilize the economy during the ZLB period is essentially undiminished when agents do not have rational expectations. Our results are robust to whether or not Ricardian equivalence holds. Finally, we show that the way in which tax policy is communicated is critical to its effectiveness.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨的问题是：在零利率下限（ZLB）约束下，财政政策的效果对理性预期假设的敏感程度如何？我们通过一个标准的新凯恩斯主义模型来研究，其中人们是动态水平k型思考者。我们的分析削弱了在ZLB约束下使用政府支出稳定经济的理由。人们越不成熟，政府支出乘数就越小。我们的分析加强了在ZLB约束下使用税收政策稳定产出的理由。当经济主体不具有理性预期时，税收政策在ZLB期间稳定经济的能力基本不受影响。我们的结果对李嘉图等价是否成立具有稳健性。最后，我们表明税收政策的沟通方式对其有效性至关重要。

articles.abstract_en: Rumors of a shortage may create higher-order uncertainty and cause panic buying even when there is no real shortage and most consumers are aware of this fact. We study the role of prices in alleviating, or even preventing, panic buying caused by such rumors. Under some circumstances, flexible prices fail to do so and panic buying is the unique equilibrium outcome. In our model consumers do not know their future tastes perfectly and panic buying reduces welfare because consumers now buy with only imperfect information about tastes. In these circumstances, a minimum support price—a price floor—prevents panic buying and leads to higher consumer surplus. Producer surplus may be higher as well.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于短缺的谣言可能产生更高阶的不确定性，并导致恐慌性购买，即使实际上并不存在短缺，且大多数消费者也意识到这一事实。我们研究了价格在缓解甚至防止此类谣言引发的恐慌性购买中的作用。在某些情况下，灵活的价格无法做到这一点，恐慌性购买是唯一的均衡结果。在我们的模型中，消费者并不完全了解自己未来的偏好，而恐慌性购买会降低福利，因为消费者现在是在对偏好信息不完全的情况下进行购买。在这些情况下，最低支持价格——即价格下限——可以防止恐慌性购买，并带来更高的消费者剩余。生产者剩余也可能更高。

articles.title_en: Contagion and equilibria in diversified financial networks
articles.title_cn: 多元化金融网络中的传染与均衡
articles.abstract_en: Diversified cross-shareholding networks are thought to be more resilient to shocks, but diversification also increases the channels by which a shock can spread. To resolve these competing intuitions we introduce a stochastic model of a diversified cross-shareholding network in which a firm's valuation depends on its cash endowment and the shares it owns in other firms. We show that a concentration of measure phenomenon emerges: almost all realized network instances drawn from any probability distribution in a wide class are resilient to contagion if endowments are sufficiently large. Furthermore, the size of a shock needed to trigger widespread financial distress increases with the exposure of firms to each other. Distributions in this class are characterized by the property that a firm's equity shares owned by others are weakly dependent yet lack “dominant” shareholders.
articles.abstract_cn: 多元化的交叉持股网络被认为对冲击更具韧性，但多元化也增加了冲击传播的渠道。为了解决这些相互矛盾的直觉，我们引入了一个多元化交叉持股网络的随机模型，其中企业的估值取决于其现金 endowment 及其在其他企业中的持股。我们证明了一种测度集中现象的出现：如果 endowment 足够大，那么从广泛类别中的任何概率分布中抽取的几乎所有实现网络实例都对传染具有韧性。此外，触发广泛金融困境所需的冲击规模随着企业之间的相互敞口增加而增加。该类别中的分布特征在于，企业被其他企业持有的股权份额具有弱依赖性，但缺乏“主导”股东。

articles.title_en: Who wants to be an auctioneer?
articles.abstract_en: This paper endogenizes the decision whether to post a mechanism or to participate in another trader's mechanism in a competing mechanisms environment. With a population of heterogeneous buyers and sellers facing standard search frictions, each trader in our market has to decide whether to post a mechanism or to visit a mechanism posted by a trader on the other side of the market. We show that the equilibrium in this market is unique and is constrained efficient. Inefficient traders (low-value buyers and high-cost sellers) choose to visit with probability one, while more efficient traders randomize between posting and visiting. The resulting allocation differs substantially from the equilibrium allocation in the market where only one side can post mechanisms, especially when trader heterogeneity is significant. This suggests that decentralized marketplaces should allow participating buyers and sellers to self-select into making or receiving offers. We also provide conditions under which posting decisions are monotone, so that more efficient types post with higher probabilities than less efficient types.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文在竞争性机制环境中，将决定是发布机制还是参与另一方交易者机制的决策内生化。在一个面临标准搜索摩擦的异质性买卖双方群体中，我们市场中的每个交易者都必须决定是发布机制还是访问市场另一方交易者发布的机制。我们证明该市场的均衡是唯一的，并且是约束有效的。低效率交易者（低价值买家和低成本卖家）选择以概率一访问，而更高效的交易者在发布和访问之间随机化。由此产生的配置与只有一方可以发布机制的市场中的均衡配置有显著差异，尤其是在交易者异质性显著时。这表明去中心化的市场应允许参与的买卖双方自我选择是发出还是接收报价。我们还提供了发布决策是单调的条件，即更高效的类型以比低效类型更高的概率发布。

articles.title_en: A model of approval with an application to list design
articles.title_cn: 带有列表设计应用的批准模型
articles.abstract_en: Online technologies enable a host of observable acts, such as wishlisting, that do not quite amount to choice meant as a final selection. Rather, they express interest and a positive attitude towards an item. We gather this type of behaviour under the term approval. With items presented as a list, we propose a model of approval. We completely characterise the model in terms of simple properties of observed approval data. We introduce and study the problem of list design. This captures situations where an interested party can manipulate the approver's behaviour by choosing the list with the aim of maximising an objective.
articles.abstract_cn: 在线技术使得许多可观察的行为成为可能，例如愿望清单，这些行为并不完全等同于作为最终选择的选择。相反，它们表达了对某个项目的兴趣和积极态度。我们将这类行为归纳为“批准”一词。在项目以列表形式呈现的情况下，我们提出了一个批准模型。我们根据观察到的批准数据的简单属性完全刻画了该模型。我们引入并研究了列表设计问题。这涵盖了感兴趣的一方可以通过选择列表来操纵批准者行为以最大化目标的情况。

articles.title_en: Communication on networks and strong reliability
articles.title_cn: 网络上的沟通与强可靠性
articles.abstract_en: We consider sender–receiver games, where the sender and the receiver are two distant nodes in a communication network. We show that if the network has two disjoint paths of communication between the sender and the receiver, then we can replicate all equilibrium outcomes not only of the direct communication game (i.e., when the sender and the receiver communicate directly with each other) but also of the mediated game (i.e., when the sender and the receiver communicate with the help of a mediator).
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑发送者-接收者博弈，其中发送者和接收者是通信网络中两个相距较远的节点。我们证明，如果网络中发送者和接收者之间存在两条不相交的通信路径，那么我们不仅可以复制直接沟通博弈（即发送者和接收者直接相互沟通时）的所有均衡结果，还可以复制中介博弈（即发送者和接收者借助中介进行沟通时）的所有均衡结果。

articles.title_en: Economic distributions, primitive distributions, and demand recovery in monopolistic competition
articles.title_cn: 垄断竞争中的经济分布、原始分布与需求恢复
articles.abstract_en: We link fundamental technological and taste distributions to endogenous economic distributions of prices and firm size (output, profit) generated under monopolistic competition with heterogeneous productivities as per recent Trade and Industrial Organization models. We derive full equivalence properties for monopoly mark-ups, demand shape, marginal revenue, and profits to match distributions of cost, price, output, and profit under monopolistic competition. Demand and one distribution determine the rest. We provide constructive proofs to recover demand and all distributions from just two (e.g., price and cost distributions uncover demand form), and derive restrictions on distribution pairs. Finally, we extend to analyze mark-up distributions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们将基本的技术与品味分布与垄断竞争下由异质性生产率产生的价格和企业规模（产出、利润）的内生经济分布联系起来，正如近期贸易和产业组织模型所述。我们推导出垄断加价、需求形状、边际收入和利润的完全等价性质，以匹配垄断竞争下的成本、价格、产出和利润分布。需求和一个分布决定其余部分。我们提供构造性证明，仅从两个分布（例如，价格和成本分布揭示需求形式）恢复需求和所有分布，并推导出分布对的限制。最后，我们扩展分析加价分布。

articles.title_en: Regret, responsibility, and randomization: A theory of stochastic choice
articles.title_cn: 遗憾、责任与随机化：随机选择理论
articles.abstract_en: I provide a model of deliberate stochastic choice over acts (state-contingent payoffs). In this model, the decision maker finds randomization desirable since it reduces responsibility and regret after the state uncertainty resolves. I provide an axiomatic characterization of stochastic choices compatible with this model. I also discuss the comparative statics and some behavioral implications of the model and outline potential avenues for extending and generalizing the model.
articles.abstract_cn: 我提供了一个关于行为（状态依存的收益）的深思熟虑的随机选择模型。在该模型中，决策者认为随机化是可取的，因为它减少了状态不确定性解决后的责任和遗憾。我提供了与该模型兼容的随机选择的公理化特征描述。我还讨论了该模型的比较静态分析和一些行为含义，并概述了扩展和推广该模型的潜在途径。

articles.title_en: Arbitrage with financial constraints and market power
articles.title_cn: 金融约束与市场势力下的套利
articles.abstract_en: I study how (VaR-based) financial constraints affect liquidity and welfare under different structures of the arbitrage industry. When capital is dispersed across competitive arbitrageurs, financial constraints may impair their ability to provide liquidity, lowering other investors' welfare. However, when capital is concentrated among arbitrageurs with market power, introducing constraints can make everyone better off and increase liquidity. Further, alternative constraints (fixed margins, position limits) have the same effects as VaR constraints when arbitrageurs are competitive, but not when they have market power. These results lead to new policy implications for margin and capital requirements and yield new empirical predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我研究了（基于VaR的）金融约束在不同套利行业结构下如何影响流动性和福利。当资本分散在竞争性套利者之间时，金融约束可能损害他们提供流动性的能力，降低其他投资者的福利。然而，当资本集中在具有市场势力的套利者手中时，引入约束可以使所有人受益并增加流动性。此外，替代性约束（固定保证金、头寸限制）在套利者竞争时与VaR约束具有相同效果，但当他们具有市场势力时则不然。这些结果对保证金和资本要求产生了新的政策含义，并产生了新的实证预测。

articles.abstract_en: Central counterparties (CCPs) are systemically important. When a clearing member defaults, the CCP sells the defaulted portfolio to surviving members in an auction, and losses, if any, are partly absorbed by a cash pool prefunded by the surviving members. We propose a tractable auction model that incorporates this salient feature. We find that “juniorization” – the CCP first uses prefunded cash of members who submit bad bids – increases the auction price. However, too aggressive juniorization can reduce members' total profit, presenting a misalignment between the CCP's objective and that of the members. A wider customer participation can increase both the auction price and the total profit of members and customers.
articles.abstract_cn: 中央对手方（CCP）具有系统重要性。当清算会员违约时，CCP通过拍卖将违约组合出售给幸存会员，损失（如有）部分由幸存会员预先注资的现金池吸收。我们提出了一个包含这一显著特征的可处理拍卖模型。我们发现，“次级化”——即CCP首先使用提交劣质报价的会员的预注资现金——会提高拍卖价格。然而，过于激进的次级化可能降低会员的总利润，导致CCP目标与会员目标之间的错位。更广泛的客户参与可以提高拍卖价格以及会员和客户的总利润。

articles.title_en: On existence of Berk-Nash equilibria in misspecified Markov decision processes with infinite spaces
articles.title_cn: 无限空间误设定马尔可夫决策过程中Berk-Nash均衡的存在性
articles.abstract_en: Model misspecification is a critical issue in many areas of economics. In the context of misspecified Markov Decision Processes, Esponda and Pouzo (2021) defined the notion of Berk-Nash equilibrium and established its existence with finite state and action spaces. However, many substantive applications (including two of the three motivating examples presented by Esponda and Pouzo) involve continuous state or action spaces, and are thus not covered by the Esponda-Pouzo existence theorem. We extend the existence of Berk-Nash equilibrium to compact action spaces and sigma-compact state spaces, with possibly unbounded utility functions. A complication arises because Berk-Nash equilibrium depends critically on Radon-Nikodym derivatives, which are bounded in the finite case but typically unbounded in misspecified continuous models. The proofs rely on nonstandard analysis, and draw on novel argumentation traceable to work of the second author on nonstandard representations of Markov processes.
articles.abstract_cn: 模型误设定是经济学许多领域中的一个关键问题。在误设定的马尔可夫决策过程背景下，Esponda和Pouzo（2021）定义了Berk-Nash均衡的概念，并在有限状态和行动空间下确立了其存在性。然而，许多实质性应用（包括Esponda和Pouzo提出的三个激励示例中的两个）涉及连续状态或行动空间，因此未被Esponda-Pouzo存在性定理所涵盖。我们将Berk-Nash均衡的存在性扩展到紧致行动空间和西格玛紧致状态空间，且效用函数可能无界。一个复杂问题出现了，因为Berk-Nash均衡关键依赖于Radon-Nikodym导数，在有限情形下这些导数有界，但在误设定的连续模型中通常无界。证明依赖于非标准分析，并借鉴了第二作者关于马尔可夫过程非标准表示的工作中可追溯的新颖论证。

articles.title_en: Benefiting from bias: Delegating to encourage information acquisition
articles.title_cn: 从偏见中获益：通过委托鼓励信息获取
articles.abstract_en: A principal delegates decisions to a biased agent. Payoffs depend on a state that the principal cannot observe. Initially, the agent does not observe the state, but he can acquire information about it at a cost. We characterize the principal's optimal delegation set. This set features a cap on high decisions and a gap around the agent's ex ante favorite decision. The set may even induce ex-post Pareto-dominated decisions. Under certain conditions on the cost of information acquisition, we show that the principal prefers delegating to an agent with a small bias than to an unbiased agent.
articles.abstract_cn: 委托人将决策委托给有偏见的代理人。收益取决于委托人无法观察到的状态。最初，代理人无法观察到该状态，但他可以花费成本获取相关信息。我们刻画了委托人的最优委托集。该集合以高决策的上限和围绕代理人事前偏好决策的缺口为特征。该集合甚至可能诱导事后帕累托占优的决策。在信息获取成本的某些条件下，我们表明委托人更倾向于委托给有小偏见的代理人，而不是无偏见的代理人。
